scope: Explicit scene-2 runtime-memory predicates; unchanged stopped native CPU/virtual clock and caller input; real IRQ1 make/break and full native restore invalidation
not_qualified: Scene action, navigation, text or workflow authority
scope_limits: Explicit fdisbull-scene-2/runtime-memory version1 only; constants and witnessed ordinary-RAM predicates under one stopped owner/epoch/deadline.
Existing scene-1 pixels, frame/domain/geometry/actions, text, SceneHandle and workflow consumers remain fenced.

independent_findings: Owner replacement between first clock read and lock acquisition now refuses before acquiring the replacement owner lock.
First failing read or evidence budget stops additional native reads; unavailable evidence stays incomplete.

count_note: Author, independent and integrated selections overlap; do not sum them as distinct cases.
